summary: The registrant filed an 8-K solely to disclose that a wholly-owned subsidiary, ABPCIC Funding V LLC, exercised an option under an existing credit agreement to increase lender commitments from $150M to $200M, with lender and administrative agent consent. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or structural change is involved. This is a routine credit facility upsizing by a business development company, not a special situation. No deal terms, premium, or board recommendation are present. The event is operational financing, warranting no risk-arb consideration.
